name: app-six-phone-wallet-flow-on-slate-blue-gradient-screens
title: Six wallet, cards, profile, QR scan and payment success screens with slate-blue gradients
whatItIs: An off-white board with 'More Control, Built Into Every Detail.' (italic serif on the last words), pill tabs and six phones: wallet with a hatched limit bar and weekly bars, cards with a big card and round actions, a card details sheet, a profile list, a QR scan with a payment sheet and a payment success sheet.
whatItMeans: Calm and precise; slate-blue gradients and hatched bars feel like private banking.
techniques: Use a white-to-slate gradient on every screen.
Present phones in a stepped grid.

vocabulary.definition: A progress bar with diagonal fill.
A panel sliding up with details.
A camera view with a code frame.
